eyebrow: A published standard, not a shortcut
code:
FAIR (Jack Jones / FAIR Institute)
also published as The Open Group's O-RA standard

Risk = Loss Event Frequency (LEF) x Loss Magnitude (LM)

...decomposed into measurable sub-factors,
not a direct guess at "Likelihood" and "Impact"
caption: Same intent as Likelihood x Impact — but every term is defined and repeatable.

steps.label: Threat Event Frequency
steps.sub: how often an attacker actually attempts the action

steps.label: x Vulnerability
steps.sub: probability a given attempt succeeds, given current controls

steps.label: = Loss Event Frequency
steps.sub: how often a successful event is expected per year

code:
TEF: ~50 attempts/year
Vulnerability: ~2% succeed (MFA in place)
-> LEF: ~1 successful compromise/year

Primary Loss: $15K-$40K (IR, remediation)
Secondary Loss Event Frequency: ~30% trigger notification
Secondary Loss Magnitude: $200K-$900K (fines, churn)
caption: Run through simulation, these ranges produce a loss distribution, not one number.
